summary: Configured 1024 MB zstd-compressed zram swap on node1 via zram-generator with swap-priority 100 (higher than the existing disk-backed /dev/vda2 swap at priority -2, so zram is preferred), verified it activates automatically at boot, and confirmed persistence and health across a full node restart with a changed boot ID.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (RHEL 9.8): existing 2G disk swap /dev/vda2 at priority -2, zram-generator not installed
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf with zram-size=1024, compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap
Ran daemon-reload and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service; dev-zram0.swap activated at 1024M priority 100, above disk swap's -2
Verified zstd algorithm active on /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm and that swap.target pulls in dev-zram0.swap automatically (generator-based unit, no manual enable required)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id 555221a1-8680-433b-ba3e-ebc874545af1, zram0 swap active and healthy
Issued backgrounded systemctl reboot on node1 so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming new boot_id b753979b-606f-4da6-b74e-45e34fc77884 (proving an actual restart occurred)
Verified post-restart recovery: zram0 swap automatically active again at 1024M/zstd/priority 100, still outranking disk swap

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB compressed in-memory swap configured
evidence.summary: zram-generator.conf sets zram-size=1024 with zstd compression; systemd-zram-setup@zram0 created a 1024 MiB swap device on /dev/zram0, confirmed active via swapon --show showing 1024M size

evidence.requirement: zram swap preferred over disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: swapon --show and /proc/swaps show /dev/zram0 at priority 100 versus /dev/vda2 (disk partition) at priority -2; higher priority swap is exhausted first by the kernel, so zram is preferred
dev-zram0.swap is a systemd-generator-created unit (Loaded: generated) wired into swap.target with no manual enable step needed; confirmed present and healthy again after the node restart
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm shows zstd selected, both before and after the restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 555221a1-8680-433b-ba3e-ebc874545af1, uptime, swapon --show, and free -h showing zram0 healthy prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' via nohup/disown returned 'reboot_scheduled' immediately, then subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable across several poll attempts, then returned with boot_id b753979b-606f-4da6-b74e-45e34fc77884, differing from the pre-restart boot_id 555221a1-8680-433b-ba3e-ebc874545af1

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required service/data
evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows fresh uptime (23:47:41, matching restart time), zram0 swap re-activated automatically at 1024M/zstd/priority 100 outranking disk swap, and dev-zram0.swap unit reported active
